about: Mats Tiffany explicitly brought into the Mat Gallery that are not in the scraped catalog (matgallery.html) or new53_rows.json. build_v5.py appends them after the new53 rows; colours come from secs here + measured accents (config/mat-accent-colors.json). img_commit = the jsDelivr commit that holds assets/mats/gallery/.webp (the page's main image base is pinned to an older commit).

rows.name: Imperial Lotus
rows.note: Tiffany Oct 20 late: allow Imperial Lotus (on her Talulah album). Photo: store's clean flat render (curl from mahjtilehaus.com, brand watermark like their other mats). Measured neutral 68.7, pink 13.1.
